# Ringtone Maker

Ringtone maker: an original ringtone or notification tune of about 30 seconds from a style and mood, a catchy loop, marimba, chiptune, lo-fi or orchestral.

## What it does
Describe the style and the mood. Claude tells you the price and makes a short original tune that loops.

**How the files are made:** each ringtone is generated by an audio model. Nothing is made until you say yes, and the price in credits comes first.

Original music only, not a copy of an existing song or artist.

## Install
In Claude Code:
```
/plugin marketplace add megascenes-app/claude-plugins
/plugin install ringtone-maker@megascenes
```

## Connecting
- Ringtone Maker talks to the MegaScenes server at `https://megascenes.com/api/claude/ringtone/mcp` (Streamable HTTP).
- Connecting opens MegaScenes: sign in, create an account, or continue without one and add your email when you pay (OAuth with PKCE). Then you come straight back to the chat.
- Each ringtone uses credits from your MegaScenes account and is priced before it runs; new accounts can start with a low-cost trial week.
- The ringtone plays in a viewer in the chat where Claude supports interactive apps; in Claude Code you get the link.

## Tools
| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `list_ringtone_models` | Models for ringtones with settings and starting prices. Read-only. |
| `estimate_ringtone_cost` | Exact price of one ringtone before it runs. Read-only. |
| `create_ringtone` | Starts one ringtone in your account. Uses credits; needs sign-in. |
| `get_ringtone` | Status and file links. Read-only. |
| `get_account` | Your plan and credit balance. Read-only. |

## Example prompts
- "Make an upbeat marimba ringtone with a light beat"
- "Create a calm lo-fi piano tune for my alarm"
- "A short chiptune jingle for notifications"

## Data and privacy
What you give for the ringtone (the style and mood you describe) goes to MegaScenes, stays in your MegaScenes account with the finished file, and is passed to the model provider that makes it. The plugin has no hooks or local scripts and sends nothing else.
- Privacy policy: https://megascenes.com/legal/privacy
- Terms of service: https://megascenes.com/legal/terms
- Documentation: https://megascenes.com/connectors#claude
- Support: https://megascenes.com/support
